title: material_card
description: EchoForge material_card document. Captures the electromagnetic surface/bulk parameters of a material used in scattering simulations. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic id, public-proxy provenance, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1. Derived from the identity-field payload.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Always the literal string 'material_card' for this schema.

schema_version.description: EchoForge schema version pin. Must equal '1.0.0' for this revision of the contract.

public_proxy_id.description: Stable, human-readable slug identifying the public-proxy material (lowercase letters, digits, and ._- separators). Forms part of the deterministic id.

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: how the document was produced, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) under which the material_card content is released.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and the per-check results that establish trust in this document.

material_name.description: Human-readable material name shown in tools and reports. Non-empty free text.

material_family.description: Coarse material taxonomy bucket. Suggested values: pec | dielectric | composite | impedance_surface | absorber | mixed. Free-form non-empty string (no strict enum at the schema layer).

frequency_range_hz.description: Validity band for the EM parameters, in Hz. Requires max >= min and min >= 0.

permittivity.description: Complex relative permittivity (epsilon_r). The real part is typically >= 1 for non-resonant passive materials; the imaginary part captures dielectric loss.

conductivity_s_per_m.description: Bulk electrical conductivity in siemens per meter (S/m). Must be >= 0.

roughness_m.description: RMS surface roughness in meters. Must be >= 0. Defaults to 0 (perfectly smooth) when omitted.
